name: Apprise API
description: One HTTP endpoint that fans a message out to a hundred notification services — Discord, Telegram, Slack, Matrix, ntfy, e-mail, SMS gateways and more — from Apprise URLs you store under a key or pass with each call. Scripts, cron jobs and Just Dashboard's own webhooks post to it. One small container; stored configurations and attachments live on its volumes.

access.note: Apprise API has no authentication of its own: anyone who reaches this address can read and change every stored configuration and send notifications through every service in it. Keep it off a public domain, or put the deployment's own password protection in front of it, and give your scripts the address on this host's network instead.

inputs.name: domain
inputs.label: Public domain
inputs.description: Optional; the address scripts post to. Apprise builds no absolute URLs, so nothing else here changes when it is set.

ports.name: http
ports.purpose: The notification API and the configuration pages

volumes.name: config
volumes.purpose: Stored Apprise configurations, one per key

update.notes: Stored configurations are plain files on the config volume, which any Apprise API version reads.
